faq.text6b6tIsAMinecraftAnarchyServerWherePl: 6b6t is a Minecraft anarchy server where players can enjoy full freedom with no rules. It offers a unique experience with commands like /tpa and /home to make exploration and gameplay smoother. Unlike many other servers, 6b6t has no queue, so you can join anytime without waiting. Thanks to advanced custom technology, the server supports up to 2,000 players at once.
faq.text6b6tWasStartedOnJanuary16th2022FromD: 6b6t was started on January 16th, 2022. From day one, it had the commands /tpa and /home. On the first day 6b6t reached 50 players online.
faq.text6b6tHasManyCommandsButTheMostFrequen: 6b6t has many commands, but the most frequently used ones are /tpa and /home. You can see the full list of commands on the commands page. The server includes essential commands for teleportation and home setting while maintaining the anarchy experience.
faq.text6b6tIsnTADirect2b2tAlternativeBecaus: 6b6t isn't a direct 2b2t alternative because it has its own unique features and direction. The administrators make independent decisions, such as updating to newer Minecraft versions ahead of 2b2t, and the server includes additional gameplay elements, like the teleportation commands.
faq.between150And250PlayersPlayAtTheSame: Between 150 and 250 players play at the same time on 6b6t during peak times and at minimum 50 players. The server supports up to 2,000 players simultaneously with no queue.
faq.is6b6tCrossPlatformForJavaAndBedrockEdit: Is 6b6t cross platform for Java and Bedrock edition?
faq.yes6b6tSupportsBothMinecraftJavaEditionA: Yes, 6b6t supports both Minecraft Java edition and Minecraft Bedrock edition. Players can join regardless of which version of Minecraft they own.
faq.text6b6tIsOver60tbInSizeRepresentingYear: 6b6t is over 60TB in size, representing years of player history and builds. The large world size ensures there's always new territory to explore and base locations to discover.
